name: Member's Mark Rotisserie Chicken Salad (Deli Tub Warning)
whyItWorks: Made with chunks of pulled rotisserie chicken and mayonnaise. While chicken is gentle, the inclusion of finely diced raw celery adds sharp, stringy cellulose bits that can irritate inflamed ulcerations.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew very thoroughly to break down celery pieces. Spread moderately on soft white bread or crackers.
